id.description: Unique identifier for the {@link UiApDataStore} instance.

dataId.description: The key of the data to be stored in the {@link UiApDataStore#dataMap}.

data.description:
The data to be stored in the data store. This will be processed through any
configured data transforms before being stored.

merge.description:
Whether to merge the received data with existing data (true) or replace completely (false).
When true, new data is merged with existing data. When false, new data replaces existing data.

title:
Specification for receiving data in a {@link UiApDataStore}.

This type is used to configure data reception in the data store. It allows components
to specify how received data should be stored and whether it should be merged with
existing data or replace it completely.
name: UiApDataStoreDataReceiveSpec
